every_position_composed.reason: Site 1 hides the left text card during camera transitions in frames 4 and 7 so the 3D anchor rack is never covered, whereas Site 2 keeps the card visible in frame 4 right on top of the left 3D cabinet and keeps a persistent card in frame 7.

explains_the_project.reason: Both sites use the exact same 3D factory metaphor—pressing a 302,628-token slab in frame 3 into a bounded digest in frame 5, storing content anchors in frame 6, and routing across seven host gates in frame 8.

craft_of_the_3d.reason: Both sites render the identical 3D scene, models, shaders, lighting, and floor grid across frames 1 through 9.

type_and_layout.reason: While typography and card design are identical in frames 1–3, 5–6, and 8–9, Site 1 clears the card in frame 4 to give the wide 3D machinery room instead of letting the text panel collide with the 3D cabinet as in Site 2's frame 4.

overall.reason: Although both sites are nearly identical builds of the same 3D visualization, Site 1 times its UI cards to clear the viewport during camera moves (frames 4 and 7) so the text panel never obscures the 3D machinery.
